Appreciate the clear asks. I put together a concise draft MAP and attached an evaluation checklist (Redwood_EvalPlan_MedAlign.xlsx) plus a one-page sequencing recommendation. High-level notes below; the attached MAP has dates tied to each owner.

Top-level sequencing recommendation (short):
- Week 0: Commercial confirmation & intake (PO intent or billing contact) — Procurement
- Week 1: DPA review & mutual comments (privacy team; can run in parallel with evaluation kick-off)
- Week 2: MSA redline pass (legal) — we recommend signing MSA before final order form where feasible to avoid rework on terms tied to service-levels
- Week 3: Order form finalization and pricing confirmation (finance + buyer PO)
- Week 4: DocuSign loop and technical onboarding kickoff

Reasoning: DPA can usually be scoped and agreed in parallel with early evaluation activities (data minimization, retention). If your procurement insists DPA precedes the order form, we can accommodate but that typically shifts the signature window by ~1 week.

Sara / Neha —

Quick legal note on sequencing to make the MAP operational:

- DPA: privacy clauses (data scope, subprocessing, retention) are frequently handled on the same cadence as evaluation activities. We can issue a standard DPA and agree on data flows quickly.
- MSA: our MSA covers indemnities, liability caps and IP — redlines here take longer if there are nonstandard request. For commercial velocity, we recommend Redwood and MedAlign agree on key commercial terms and sign an Order Form that references our MSA as "pending signature" with a defined fallback (i.e., executing the MSA within X days). This keeps technical onboarding moving while legal completes the MSA redline pass.
- Order Form: should be used to lock pricing, scope, and pilot length. If you require the DPA to be fully executed before the Order Form, please flag and we will sequence accordingly.

I will circulate the MSA + redline spreadsheet by EOD Friday and include a suggested fallback clause to keep onboarding untethered from protracted MSA edits.

-Karthik
